transform_notes: MVKE is keyed by MATNR (+ Sales Org + Distribution Channel), not by an independent product ID. Product_ID is this sheet's own row identifier, not a value that needs to survive migration -- Item_ID is the real join key back to the material master.

Same Company Code -> Sales Org gap as Sales Orders>Company_ID. Distribution Channel (VTWEG) has no source column at all -- MVKE's full key needs both, so this needs an org-structure decision, not just a lookup.

The real join key -- must resolve to the SAME MATNR value used for this item in the Inventory Items mapping (both currently use the raw Item_ID as a staging key, so they agree by construction; if Inventory Items>Item_Code is later promoted to the live MATNR instead, this column must be re-resolved through that same mapping, not left pointing at the old value).

This sales-view row's own code, not the material's. No analogous 'old number' field on MVKE the way MARA has BISMT -- once linked to the base material via MATNR, this code doesn't need to survive separately.

Verified byte-for-byte identical to Inventory Items>Item_Name for the same Item_ID on all 15 rows. Already migrated via MAKT-MAKTX in the Inventory Items mapping -- mapping it again here would be a redundant duplicate, not a second real value.

A second, sales-side classification field alongside Inventory Items>Item_Category_ID (-> MTART). Whether these should collapse into one SAP classification or genuinely represent two different concepts (material type vs. material group) is an open question -- not investigated as thoroughly as the Country case; flag for a consistency check rather than assuming either resolution.

A full-sentence sales description, not a short code -- would need a proper SAP long-text object (e.g. via STXH/STXL), not a flat field. Out of scope for a single-field transform; flagged for the AI mapping agent rather than force-fit.
Resolve via Inventory>Units of Measure lookup (-> T006) -- same field and pattern as Sales Order Lines>UOM_ID.
Verified identical to Inventory Items>Unit_Cost for the same Item_ID on all 15 rows -- already migrated via MBEW-STPRS in the Inventory Items mapping.

No flat sales-price field on MVKE -- pricing is condition-driven in standard SD (KONV / S/4's PRCD_ELEMENTS), the same finding as Sales Orders>Unit_Price. Loading this value means creating a price condition record, not writing to a field.

MVKE itself has no currency field in this catalog (pricing currency lives on the condition records that List_Price would also need); listed here only to flag that Currency and List_Price are a matched pair -- resolving one without the other doesn't make sense.

Weight belongs on MARA (base material data, general across all sales orgs), not MVKE (a sales-org-specific view) -- but MARA rows are built from the Inventory Items sheet, not this one. Populating it from here would mean enriching an already-created MARA row with a field from a second source sheet, which the current transform engine doesn't support (each spec writes fresh rows, it doesn't merge into existing ones by key). Flagged as a real engine gap, not force-fit around.
